newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 5.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Thursday edition:

WASHINGTON - Joseph Hendrick III, the country's largest car dealer, was charged by a federal jury in Asheville, North Carolina, with bribing former executives of American Honda Motor Co. for more than 10 years.

WASHINGTON - Stanford University economist Michael Boskin unveiled the the price index plan formulated by a congressionally appointed panel, a move that could boost chances of President Clinton and congressional Republicans closing a balanced-budget deal this year.
WASHINGTON - Area stores are unable to keep up with the Christmas demand for the new Nintendo video game system.

WASHINGTON - In a stinging rebuke of the National Credit Union Administration, a federal judge called it "a rogue federal agency" that is acting like a trade group protecting the industry it is charged with overseeing.
